change: Reject a batch row when its valid item_id and valid entity_id resolve to different requested entities; otherwise retain item_id-first mapping with entity_id fallback.

deterministic_checks.consistent_reordered_rows: accepted and restored to original roster order
deterministic_checks.disagreeing_valid_identifiers: both rows rejected to per-entity fallback
deterministic_checks.duplicate_policy: first accepted row per entity remains authoritative
deterministic_checks.partial_batch: returned entity preserved; missing entity alone falls back

hypothesis: Requiring consistent item_id and entity_id when both resolve prevents cross-entity model outputs without reducing valid reordered or partial batch completion.
predictive_quality_claim: none; evidence isolation and engineering reliability improvement only
reason: Closes a shared cross-entity typed-schema ambiguity while preserving valid order-independent batching, partial fallback, all offline public answers, and every official smoke gate.
